Name: Kitty Custom Furniture
Author: Robokit12
Description:
OUTDATED MOD! Please note! I don´t plan on modding anymore. But if someone feels like it don't hesitate to change/update and reupload any of my files. I wouldn´t mind it.

Wouldn´t it be nice having a cat you don´t have to look after!? I got a decorative, fluffy hairball for you. Hope you enjoy :)!

Now also availabe as DGA file! A huge THANK YOU to  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/122749553]PUFFEEYDII[/url] for converting the original data <3 <3 <3!

[b]Includes:[/b]

Scratching Post with Cat (animated decor)
Food & Water Bowl
Cat Portrait

All items can be bought at Robins Carpenter Shop (also available via Furniture Catalogue).
 
[b]Installation: [/b]Just download the file and extract it to your mod folder.

Please note that items may conflict with other installed custom furniture if those were created with Platonymous Custom Furniture Mod! If this happens just open the KittyFurniture.json file and change the "id" number to something else that isn´t used yet (e.g. 20 to 201).
